cues.en: So far in this section, I have focused on token level evaluations and sentence level evaluations.
cues.zh: 本章到目前，聚焦詞元與句子層級評估。

cues.en: Now I will introduce you to a higher level of evaluating language generation, which is to focus on
cues.zh: 現在介紹較高層次的生成評估，關注

cues.en: the distributional statistics of longer sequences of tokens that the model outputs.
cues.zh: 模型輸出較長詞元序列的分布統計。

cues.en: The idea is to see if the probability distribution of tokens that a model generates is consistent with the distribution of tokens from human written text.
cues.zh: 概念是看模型生成詞元的機率分布，是否與人類文本一致。

cues.en: I will get into the details of how these kinds of methods work in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支會詳細介紹這類方法。

cues.en: And in this video, I will tell you about the main quantification of distributional statistics, which
cues.zh: 這支先介紹主要量化方式，

cues.en: is based on a measure called the Kullback-Leibler divergence, often simplified to KL divergence.
cues.zh: 根據稱為 Kullback–Leibler 散度的指標，通常簡稱 KL 散度。

cues.en: And it's also called KL distance because it can be used as a measure of distance.
cues.zh: 也叫 KL 距離，因為能當成某種距離衡量。

cues.en: In fact, I've already introduced you to KL divergence earlier in the course, although I didn't go into much detail about the math.
cues.zh: 前面其實介紹過，但沒有深入數學。

cues.en: So imagine that we have two probability distributions indicated by these two different colored lines.
cues.zh: 假設有兩個機率分布，用兩條不同顏色的線表示。

cues.en: X would correspond to all of the tokens in the vocab, and perhaps the orange line is the probability
cues.zh: x 對應詞彙表全部詞元，橘線也許是

cues.en: of different tokens that are observed in human written text.
cues.zh: 人類文字中，各詞元的出現機率。

cues.en: For example, in Wikipedia articles and the yellow line is the probability distribution over tokens that an LX has generated.
cues.zh: 例如維基百科文章；黃線則是 LLM 生成詞元的機率分布。

cues.en: Now, if we want the language model to produce text that has the same distribution as the human written
cues.zh: 如果希望語言模型產生與人類文字

cues.en: text, then we want these two lines to be very similar.
cues.zh: 相同的分布，就希望兩條線非常相似。

cues.en: Now here they are not really that similar, which would indicate that the global statistics of token probabilities are different between the model and the human.
cues.zh: 但這裡不太像，表示模型與人類的詞元整體機率統計不同。

cues.en: Of course, all of this is highly dependent on choosing the right pieces of text.
cues.zh: 當然，非常取決於選了哪些文本。

cues.en: For example, if the orange line is human written Twitter text and the yellow line is AI written Python
cues.zh: 例如，橘線是人類 Twitter 貼文，黃線是 AI 的 Python

cues.en: code, then we really wouldn't actually expect or even want those two distributions to be that similar.
cues.zh: 程式，就不會預期，甚至不希望分布很相似。

cues.en: So choosing a correct reference text is really important.
cues.zh: 所以選對參照文本很重要。

cues.en: And I'll have more to say about that in the next two videos.
cues.zh: 接下來兩支還會談。

cues.en: So here is again the formula for KL divergence.
cues.zh: 這裡再次顯示 KL 散度公式。

cues.en: It's the probability of x.
cues.zh: 是 x 的機率，

cues.en: So p of x times the log of p divided by Q now, when you sum up over all of those values for x, that
cues.zh: p(x) 乘上 log(p/q)，對所有 x

cues.en: gives one number and that is the KL divergence value.
cues.zh: 加總，得到一個 KL 散度數值。

cues.en: In the context of deep learning, it's often used as a loss function.
cues.zh: 深度學習裡，常當作損失函數。

cues.en: You will remember that we used exactly this measure as a loss function earlier in the course.
cues.zh: 記得，前面正是使用這個指標作損失，

cues.en: In the videos, where we trained a model to prefer tokens that have the letter X in them.
cues.zh: 訓練模型偏好包含字母 x 的詞元。

cues.en: We actually did that twice in two separate videos.
cues.zh: 在兩支不同影片，做過兩次。

cues.en: Now, in the next couple of videos on evaluations, we're going to use this formula not as a loss function,
cues.zh: 但接下來評估影片，不把它當損失，

cues.en: but as a way of measuring the similarity between text and human text.
cues.zh: 而是衡量模型文字與人類文字的相似程度。

cues.en: Now let's take a moment and think about what these different values could mean.
cues.zh: 花點時間思考，不同數值代表什麼。

cues.en: First of all, you always need to assign one probability distribution to be the input and the other to be the target.
cues.zh: 第一，總要指定一個分布是輸入，另一個是目標。

cues.en: The input probability distribution is the one that you are considering, and the target is the distribution that you're using as reference or comparison.
cues.zh: 輸入是正在考慮的分布，目標則是用來參照、比較的分布。

cues.en: I will show you in Python in a moment that that makes a big difference, and you get different results depending on which distribution you consider to be the target.
cues.zh: 等一下會用 Python 示範，這差很多，交換目標會得到不同結果。

cues.en: Secondly, you have to make sure that these really are probability distributions that follow the two conditions of a true probability distribution.
cues.zh: 第二，必須確認真的是符合兩個條件的機率分布。

cues.en: So all non-negative and they all sum to one.
cues.zh: 全部非負，總和為 1。

cues.en: If you try to use vectors in here that are not true probability distributions, you are going to get weird uninterpretable and incorrect results.
cues.zh: 若向量不是真正機率分布，會得到奇怪、無法解讀、錯誤的結果。

cues.en: Third, I will show you in a moment in the Python demo that PyTorch expects P to be log probabilities,
cues.zh: 第三，Python 會看到，PyTorch 預期 P 是對數機率，

cues.en: and you can input whether Q is either in raw probability or log probability.
cues.zh: Q 則可以用原始機率或對數機率輸入。

cues.en: Just something to keep in mind about the implementation.
cues.zh: 只是實作上要注意。

cues.en: Anyway, let's look at this formula and think about how to interpret it.
cues.zh: 總之，看公式，思考如何解讀。

cues.en: First let's consider the case where the two distributions p and q are exactly identical.
cues.zh: 先考慮 P 與 Q 完全相同。

cues.en: In that case, p over q is one.
cues.zh: 這時 p/q=1。

cues.en: The log of one is zero, which would mean that the KL divergence would be zero.
cues.zh: log(1)=0，所以 KL 散度為零。

cues.en: So that's the smallest possible value that we can expect.
cues.zh: 這是最小可能值。

cues.en: And the more different the two probability distributions the larger the KL divergence.
cues.zh: 兩分布越不同，散度越大。

cues.en: There's no upper bound.
cues.zh: 沒有上界。

cues.en: So KL divergence can keep getting larger.
cues.zh: 可以一直增加。

cues.en: It grows unbounded as the distributions become more dissimilar.
cues.zh: 隨分布更不同，無界增長。

cues.en: The last point I want to discuss about this equation is that KL divergence is non-negative, so it can be zero or positive, but it cannot be negative.
cues.zh: 最後要談，KL 散度非負，可以是零或正，不能負。

cues.en: Now, that may initially seem counterintuitive because the values where q is greater than p, then this
cues.zh: 乍看可能不直覺，因為 Q 大於 P 時，

cues.en: ratio will be less than one and the log of that will be negative.
cues.zh: 比值小於 1，log 為負。

cues.en: So there can indeed be negative values in this sum, although they will all wash out and it will always end up being positive.
cues.zh: 所以加總中確實可以有負項，但全部相抵後，總會是正。

cues.en: There's a longer mathematical proof for why that has to be the case.
cues.zh: 這有比較長的數學證明。

cues.en: I'm not going to go through that proof, but I will tell you some intuition.
cues.zh: 這裡不證明，只提供直覺。

cues.en: So the intuition is that you can think about this as a weighted ratio.
cues.zh: 可以把它想成加權比值。

cues.en: So this ratio is weighted by probability distribution p.
cues.zh: 比值用分布 P 加權。

cues.en: Now anywhere where q is greater than p that means that p is going to be small.
cues.zh: Q 大於 P 的位置，表示 P 較小，

cues.en: Which means that the negative number from the log will have a small or minuscule impact on the sum.
cues.zh: 所以負的 log 對總和，影響較小、甚至微乎其微。

cues.en: And in contrast, wherever p is larger than q, this ratio will be greater than one and the log will be positive and those weightings will be relatively larger.
cues.zh: 相反地，P 大於 Q，比值大於 1，log 為正，而權重相對較大。

cues.en: So you actually can get negative values inside the sum.
cues.zh: 因此，總和裡能有負值，

cues.en: But you're never going to get a negative KL distance.
cues.zh: 但 KL 距離永遠不會負。

cues.en: And actually if you do run an analysis where you get a negative result, then it's certainly because something went wrong.
cues.zh: 真的算出負值，肯定某處出錯。

cues.en: And probably what went wrong is that the distributions were not normalized to be true probability distributions.
cues.zh: 可能是分布沒有正規化成真正機率分布。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Here is what we are going to do in the Python demo.
cues.zh: Python 會做這些事。

cues.en: I will create two data sets of random numbers and then calculate their probability distributions which you can see here.

cues.zh: 兩者相當相似，但明顯不完全相同。

cues.en: Remember that I said that you get different results depending on which probability distribution you consider the target distribution.
cues.zh: 記得，指定哪個為目標，結果會不同。

cues.en: Then I will show you how to implement KL divergence using PyTorch, and confirm that we get the same results as we got with the manual implementation in numpy.
cues.zh: 再用 PyTorch 實作，確認與 NumPy 手算結果一致。

cues.en: Now the implementation in PyTorch is a little bit different because as you learned earlier in the course
cues.zh: PyTorch 實作稍有不同，因為前面

cues.zh: 用 KL 當損失時學過，它要對數機率，不是原始機率。

cues.en: Anyway, let's switch to code and have a look.
cues.zh: 切到程式看看。

cues.zh: 樣本數一萬。

cues.zh: 這些叫對數常態分布。

cues.en: It's kind of like a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 先有常態分布，

cues.en: And you push it through the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 再取自然指數。

cues.en: People always ask me in my statistics or machine learning courses why is this called a log normal distribution when there's no log in there?
cues.zh: 在統計或機器學習課，大家常問：裡面沒有 log，為什麼叫對數常態？

cues.en: Wouldn't you call this a log normal distribution?
cues.zh: 不該把這個叫對數常態嗎？

cues.en: The answer to that question is that if you would take the log of a log normal distribution, you get
cues.zh: 答案是，對對數常態取 log，會得到

cues.en: a normal distribution because the log and the natural exponential are inverse functions of each other.
cues.zh: 常態，因為 log 與自然指數互為反函數。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: That has nothing to do with KL divergence okay.
cues.zh: 這與 KL 散度無關。

cues.en: Here I'm just mean centering it and z scoring it actually just to shift it a little bit.
cues.zh: 這裡先做平均中心化與 z 分數標準化，只是稍微平移。

cues.en: And then here I have a standard normal distribution also z squared although that's not really strictly necessary because of this distribution.
cues.zh: 另一組是標準常態，也做 z 分數標準化，但因分布本身如此，其實不太必要。

cues.en: But anyway.
cues.zh: 總之，

cues.en: So here I calculate their histograms, and here I convert to a probability density estimate by dividing by the sum.
cues.zh: 計算直方圖，再除以總和，轉成機率密度估計。

cues.en: Now why am I doing any of this stuff when I already have the data?
cues.zh: 既然已有資料，為何還做這些？

cues.en: Well what we need to evaluate is not the data themselves but the probability distribution of the data.
cues.zh: 因為要評估的是分布，不是資料本身。

cues.en: So KL divergence is not calculated from data.
cues.zh: KL 散度不是直接從資料計算，

cues.en: It's calculated from a probability distribution over data.
cues.zh: 而是從資料的機率分布。

cues.en: Now if you are working with pure math functions you have the moment generating functions.
cues.zh: 純數學函數，可以有動差生成函數，

cues.en: You can get the pure PDF.
cues.zh: 取得精確的機率密度函數。

cues.en: But in real data.
cues.zh: 但真實、

cues.en: In empirical data we do not have the moment generating functions as mathematical expressions.
cues.zh: 經驗資料，沒有以數學式寫出的動差生成函數。

cues.en: So instead we need to estimate the probability Distributions based on the measured data that we actually
cues.zh: 所以必須根據實際量到的

cues.en: have.
cues.zh: 資料，估計機率分布。

cues.en: And the way to do that is by calculating the histogram.
cues.zh: 方式就是算直方圖。

cues.en: So we calculate the histogram.
cues.zh: 計算直方圖，

cues.en: Here I'm defining these edges to be the smallest to the largest values in data one and data two.
cues.zh: 把組界設成兩組資料的最小到最大值，

cues.en: Just so that we get the exact same bins for both of these data sets.

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.zh: 得到次數形式的高度。

cues.en: And now so these are do not conform to a probability distribution because they do not sum to one.

cues.en: They are all positive valued or non-negative valued but they don't sum to one.

cues.zh: 因此除以總和。

cues.en: And now at the end we have y1 and y2, which we can consider to be probability functions.
cues.zh: 最後得到 y1、y2，可以視為機率函數。

cues.en: And here you see what the two distributions look like.
cues.zh: 這裡顯示兩個分布。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So now I'm going to calculate the divergence.
cues.zh: 現在計算散度。

cues.en: The divergence score is here.
cues.zh: 散度分數在這裡。

cues.en: So k distance.
cues.zh: 也就是 KL 距離。

cues.en: So here you see I have actually let me start with this one.
cues.zh: 這裡，先看這個。

cues.en: So here I have y1.
cues.zh: 有 y1，

cues.en: This is the probability of data set one and y2 is the probability of data set two.
cues.zh: 資料集一的機率；y2 是資料集二的機率。

cues.en: So in the parlance of the equation that I showed in the slides this would be p and this would be q.
cues.zh: 按投影片公式，這是 P，這是 Q。

cues.en: So I have p times the log of p divided by q.
cues.zh: 所以 P 乘以 log(P/Q)。

cues.en: Now that's all fine.
cues.zh: 這沒問題。

cues.en: The problem is that if any one of these is zero, we are going to run into trouble.
cues.zh: 但只要有任何一個零，就會麻煩。

cues.en: If y2 is zero for any given values of x.
cues.zh: 如果 y2 在某個 x 等於零，

cues.en: So for any values here along this distribution, if we have probability values of exactly zero, if
cues.zh: 也就是這條分布某個位置的機率恰好零，

cues.en: they're in q or here I call this variable y2, then we are dividing by zero which is problematic.
cues.zh: 若它在 Q，也就是 y2，就會除以零，有問題。

cues.en: And if they are in p which here I'm calling Recalling Y1.
cues.zh: 如果在 P，這裡叫 y1，

cues.en: That is also problematic because in this will be zero and the log of zero is not a finite number, it's
cues.zh: 同樣有問題，因為這裡是零，log(0) 不是有限數字，

cues.en: minus it gets represented as minus infinity, but it's not really a finite number.
cues.zh: 會表示成負無限大，但不是有限數。

cues.en: So basically zeros anywhere are going to give us problems.
cues.zh: 所以零出現在哪裡，都可能造成問題。

cues.zh: 有幾個解法。

cues.en: So just some epsilon some really tiny number.
cues.zh: 就是 epsilon，很小的數。

cues.en: And then we could say like this we could add epsilon to y2 and then add epsilon like this.

cues.zh: 如此不需要這個遮罩，

cues.en: We wouldn't need the mask and so on.

cues.en: This is perfectly fine.
cues.zh: 這完全可以。

cues.en: Basically this is guaranteeing that any values that are zero are not going to be dividing by zero.
cues.zh: 基本上，確保零不會拿來當分母，

cues.en: And we don't take the log of zero.
cues.zh: 也不會取 log(0)。

cues.en: And when Y1 actually is zero, then the log of that is going to be like -10,000 or something like that,
